com.elotouch.library

Class EloPeripheralManager.EthernetLinkMode

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.elotouch.library.EloPeripheralManager.EthernetLinkMode
  • Enclosing class:
    EloPeripheralManager

    public class EloPeripheralManager.EthernetLinkMode
extends java.lang.Object
    Ethernet link mode class to control ethernet speed and duplex like as ethtool.

    Supported link modes: 10Mb/Half 10Mb/Full 100Mb/Half 100Mb/Full 1000Mb/Full.

    The model that has Ethernet device supports this feature.

    Note: Make sure Ethernet device exist and enabled when you want to control ethernet speed and duplex.

    • Method Detail

      • setLinkMode

        public void setLinkMode(int mode,
                        android.os.Message onComplete)
        Set Ethernet link mode to change link parameters including speed,duplex and auto-negotiation.

        Note: if Ethernet device doesn't exist or Ethernet is not enabled, ignore this request directly.

        Parameters:
        mode - one of ETH_LINK_MODE_XXX as defined above.
        onComplete - a callback message when the action is completed.if onComplete is null or onComplete.replyTo is null, don't send callback message when completed.

      • getLinkMode

        public int getLinkMode()
        Get the latest Ethernet link mode which is set by user, the default mode is auto.
        Returns:
        ETH_LINK_MODE_XXX as defined above.

        Note: if Ethernet device doesn't exist, return ETH_LINK_MODE_UNKNOWN.
